verdict.rationale: The dot's own documented app connections let it read and update documents in Google Drive, and it can work with local files from a connected computer, so iterative document editing is thinly supported. Missing for 10: explicit document creation, presentation or slide creation, other file types, export or download of outputs, and any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have the assistant create and iteratively edit documents, presentations, and other files I can export
